entities.name: Friedrich Siebert
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Friedrich Siebert was a general in the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany who commanded the XIII Corps during World War II. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross. Siebert was a member of the Nazi Party.
